protocol_metadata.about: Pendle V2 is a yield trading protocol that allows users to split yield-bearing assets (like stETH, weETH, or sUSDe) into Principal Tokens (PT) and Yield Tokens (YT), enabling trading of spot yield, locking in fixed yield, or going long yield with leverage. Users deposit a yield-bearing asset to receive PTs (which redeem at face value at maturity) and YTs (which capture all yield generated until maturity), then trade these tokens on Pendle's AMM. The protocol uses a Diamond proxy architecture for its Router V3, a vePENDLE voting-escrow model for governance and fee distribution, and deploys across 14+ chains. As of September 2026, Pendle holds approximately $1.2B TVL with 80% of protocol revenue distributed to sPENDLE holders.
